octāvārĭus , a, um, adj. id.,
I.of or belonging to the eighth part (post-class.): “vectigal,” a tax of the eighth part, Cod. Just. 7, 4, 65 .—
II. Subst.: octāvārĭus , ĭi, m., a receiver of this tax: octavarii vectigal accipiant, Cod. Th. 4, 12, 8; cf. octavus, II. B.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
